title: Horizontal: two rows
note: Default layout. Row 1 holds the Workspace chip, pinned tabs and Today tabs with full-width titles. Row 2 is the toolbar, drawn at the top of the page card so the selected tab joins it: back/forward/reload, a flexible address pill with the Guard shield, and Favorites tiles on the right.

title: Horizontal: two rows, Work Workspace
note: Two-row layout in the Work Workspace (Clean theme override, Tide tint, six Favorites, a folder in Today).

title: Horizontal: one row, dense
note: The dense option. Address pill, Guard shield, navigation and Favorites tiles are merged into the single tab strip. Dusk tint in Vivid, pinned tabs and a Reading folder, a sleeping tab and an audio tab.

title: Horizontal: one row, Work Workspace
note: Dense layout in Work, with its own Clean theme override.

title: Horizontal: crowded, icon-only tabs
note: Seventeen Today tabs. Tabs shrink to the minimum width and drop titles and close buttons; the selected tab keeps its raised shape.

title: Horizontal: crowded, one row
note: The same seventeen tabs in the dense layout, where the strip also has to hold the address pill and Favorites.

title: Horizontal: folder dropdown
note: The Reading folder tab open, listing its tabs and the nested Recipes folder.

title: Horizontal: Workspace menu
note: The Workspace chip menu with Ctrl+Shift+1 to 3 hints.

title: Horizontal: two rows, compact
note: Compact density in the two-row layout: 34px tab strip, 34px toolbar, 22px Favorites tiles, 16px favicons.

title: Horizontal: OLED theme
note: OLED is dark only. The page card gets a hairline border, so the selected tab is outlined instead of flared.

title: Horizontal: overflow, scrolled
note: About 25 Today tabs. Even icon-only tabs do not fit, so the Today group scrolls with fade edges and chevrons; the selected (last) tab is kept in view and keeps a 120px minimum.
